evals.prompt: Start building Phase 3 of this project.
evals.expected_output: Does not start coding. First locates the spec (PLAN.md/SPEC.md or a file named in CLAUDE.md), reads the Phase 3 section, and restates its explicit done-criteria before doing anything. If no plan/spec exists or the phase is undefined, it STOPS and asks where the spec lives rather than guessing.
assertions: Finds and reads the plan/spec section for the phase before writing code
STOPS and asks if no plan exists or the phase scope is undefined

evals.prompt: The plan says task T3.2 must be implemented on a stronger/design model, but you're running on a small model. Implement T3.2.
evals.expected_output: Honors the per-task model assignment instead of implementing on the current cheaper model. Runs the implementation on the assigned model — delegating to a subagent spawned with that exact model — rather than writing the feature code off-model to save time.
assertions: Recognizes the plan's per-task model assignment and honors it
Delegates implementation to a subagent on the assigned model rather than coding it off-model
Does not downgrade the assignment to save time

evals.prompt: While building Phase 2 (add the API endpoint), also go ahead and add the caching layer and admin dashboard from Phase 5 since you're in there.
evals.expected_output: Declines to pull later-phase work forward. Builds only what Phase 2's done-criteria require, test-first, and leaves Phase 5 (caching, admin dashboard) until its own phase — no speculative abstractions or future-proofing.
assertions: Stays strictly within the current phase's scope
Refuses to pull Phase 5 work forward / avoids speculative abstractions
Builds the phase test-first via the development loop

evals.prompt: You finished the phase — the tests pass. Wrap up.
evals.expected_output: Does not stop at 'tests pass'. Verifies by also running typecheck/lint, a build, and exercising the real behavior; updates the plan (prunes the completed entry / records durable decisions); and reports files changed, test counts/names, and verification output. Does NOT git commit unless the human asked.
assertions: Verifies beyond unit tests (typecheck/lint, build, real behavior exercised)
Updates the plan and reports files changed + results + any deviation
Does not git commit unless explicitly asked
